extDescription.message: An ambient glow in the black bars of the Netflix player. Colors follow the picture, like a TV with ambient lighting.

actionTitle.message: CinéHalo: click to turn on the glow for this tab

cmdToggle.message: Turn the glow on or off

ecoAutoHint.message: Fewer captures and zones on battery

bakedBarsHint.message: Also detects black bars encoded inside the video

status_not_netflix.message: Open a movie or a show on Netflix, the glow takes care of the rest.

status_reload.message: Reload the Netflix tab to turn CinéHalo on.

status_not_watch.message: Start playing something to see the glow.

status_needs_click.message: Click the CinéHalo icon to allow capture in this tab.

status_black.message: The capture comes back black, DRM is probably blocking the picture on this setup.

blackTip.message: On Windows, turning off Chrome's hardware acceleration (Settings > System) and relaunching may help. It isn't guaranteed.

status_detecting.message: Looking for black bars in the picture…

status_no_bars.message: No black bars here, the glow stays off.
